_comment: The estate's privacy policy (R31), created 2026-10-03 at the owner's instruction. Any path that
matches a rule is reduced to a hash and a category before it leaves the node, so it is never
listed by name anywhere in the map. A plain string matches as a case-insensitive SUBSTRING of the
path; "/.../flags" is a regular expression. Too broad a rule withholds more, never leaks more.
If this file is absent or malformed, the hub refuses EVERY map. Edit it; never delete it to turn
it off. The hub reads it when it starts, so restart Prime-Silo after changing it.
